cards.title: Coze Multi-Agent Orchestration
cards.role: AI PM · ByteDance AI Full-Stack Challenge · Top 3
cards.oneLine: Multi-agent workflow orchestration — recommend the right flow instead of making users compose one.
cards.summary: Lower the barrier for AI-coding novices to complete complex tasks and improve orchestration reuse for experienced users, through workflows tailored to each development task.
cards.details: Choosing the wrong multi-agent workflow wastes the execution cost of every downstream node, so success was defined as accurately identifying applicable boundaries and distinguishing easily-confused scenarios. Defined metadata for task type, applicable scenarios, agent roles, I/O, process nodes and constraints, and built a 30-case evaluation set including confusable items. Bad-case attribution pointed at insufficient model knowledge, so the engineering layer gained 5-shot examples with positive/negative cases and reasoning explanations, using an ICE-structured prompt with schema-structured output to avoid hallucination.
cards.impact: Shipped workflow recommendations, a visual editor and a template marketplace. Top 3 at the challenge.

cards.title: Kaboo — Token Efficiency
cards.role: AI PM · ByteDance internal open source
cards.oneLine: Existing stats answered "how much was consumed", never "which consumption was wasteful".
cards.summary: Token-consumption analytics platform. Led the Token Efficiency Leaderboard and the efficiency analysis module, now covering thousands of internal users.
cards.details: Defined judgment criteria for five waste categories — ineffective retries, redundant tool definitions, redundant context, cache misses and over-provisioned model selection. Designed a diagnostic scheme that collects only structured metadata, never task content, and normalised cross-model cost with an Effective Tokens metric.
